why: Sector compact signed under the Ministry of Education records that the Sistema Integrado de Gestao Escolar (SIGE/EMIS) has been introduced and is being developed with the World Bank to link central and district levels, and describes the education data layer as still being built rather than exchanging data with other systems
AFAP tender for specialist technical assistance for SIGE implementation, dating the system as still at implementation stage in April 2026
UNICEF tender for development of dashboards for national education supervision, a distinct commissioning of an education data and monitoring layer

The Ministry of Health own page for the Sistema de Informacao da Saude, stating the SIS runs on DHIS2 with national data storage, and dating the DHIS2 launch to December 2019 and DHIS2 Tracker to October 2020
UNDP tender UNDP-STP-00136 commissioning an independent evaluation of the health digitisation project covering DHIS2, mSupply and Instalacoes Inteligentes
The DPSSF own page for Kenon, the Sistema Nacional de Informacao da Protecao Social, establishing the system exists and that its stated exchange function is internal to DPSSF departments and partners
World Bank additional financing paper records Kenon adopted in 2024 on CORE-MIS and openIMIS, government-owned and operated, and integrated with the Unique Social Registry covering 8,740 families

World Bank mission aide-memoire proposes a joint DGRN and DPSSF campaign pairing the Cadastro Social Unico update with mass digital ID registration, supported by a shared database with differentiated access and a unified collection form

Council of Ministers resolution published in the Diario da Republica approving the Estrategia Nacional para a Governacao Digital, whose annex mandates a Plataforma de Interoperabilidade as the structuring layer for integrating public services and validating citizen identities

World Bank mission aide-memoire records live demonstration of functional prototypes of the interoperability and data exchange platform named DEX, and sets March 2026 for integrating the interoperability layer with the verifiable credentials infrastructure

The DGRN own entry page for legi non, stating it is the interface to the life-events database through which root identification of all Sao Tomeans is carried out, allowing electronic validation of paper documents and machine-to-machine exchange between accredited public administration systems

World Bank mission aide-memoire records the System Integrator beginning work on a new foundational bilhete de identidade that will be a digital ID, with a MOSIP approach, and proposes pairing its mass registration with the Cadastro Social Unico update
AFAP tender for acquisition of biometric kits for digital identity registration under the World Bank Sao Tome e Principe Digital project, a distinct procurement of the enrolment hardware

The same Council of Ministers resolution is the founding instrument for authentication: its annexed strategy mandates a Plataforma de Autenticacao based on single sign-on fully integrated with Identidade Digital management, and a state certification infrastructure providing qualified digital signature

World Bank mission aide-memoire demonstrates prototypes of the verifiable credentials infrastructure and the electronic signature service, sets May 2026 for electronic signature conditional on the Lei de Assinatura Eletronica, and records that law as approved by the Council of Ministers and submitted to the Assembleia

World Bank ID4D diagnostic records that the DGRN began digitising civil registry and civil identification in 2017 and implemented SIGA in 2018, enabling digital registration of life events across the country, with a centralised civil registry database

Chief conservator of the Registo Civil states an electronic system now allows births to be registered automatically and entered directly into the database, with free registration up to one year in all maternity units staffed by DGRN technicians and trained nurse-midwives

The ID4D diagnostic is the standing description of the link between civil registration and identification: SIGA registering all life event types and a centralised civil registry database, with tables on birth registration and civil identification

PReSE public session presents an automatic voter registration platform under development by the Universidade de Aveiro, with equipment delivered to reinforce the security of the civil registry systems and Web and WebAPI training for DGRN and CEN technicians

World Bank mission aide-memoire records INIC and DGRN jointly leading digital identity implementation, a MOSIP approach for the new foundational identity, and the Lei de Documento agregado de identificacao still pending
The ID4D diagnostic is the standing account of what the identification system is and how far its data is shared, covering SIGA, the centralised civil registry database and civil identification

Ministry of Foreign Affairs announces non-presential passport issuance under paragraph 5 of Decreto-Lei number 1/2026, requiring a copy of a valid Bilhete de Identidade whose authenticity is verified by the Servico de Migracao e Fronteiras

Camoes records a national free Bilhete de Identidade campaign run by the DGRN until 15 March 2026 and states the BI will become the base document for automatic and permanent voter registration from civil registry data
